figures.caption: Figure 1. High-level architecture of PAEF. Each metric module targets one or more failure mode families and exposes a MetricResult object with a normalised score, confidence estimate, and structured metadata for downstream alerting or dashboarding. All metrics run locally on sentence-transformers — no external API calls, no rate limits.
Table 2. FM-3 — Distribution collapse over five weekly windows. Accuracy remains flat throughout; PAEF diversity metrics surface the collapse at W3.
Table 3. FM-2 — Silent degradation via tool partial responses. PAEF flags the failure at Stage 2; external accuracy moves only −0.03 across all four stages.

Table 6. Summary: PAEF detection vs. standard metric signals. Standard metrics either provide no signal or a lagged, sub-threshold signal. PAEF detects all four failure modes within one evaluation cycle.
